Toedscool

Ground Grass

Paldea · Generation 9

Toedscool is a Ground/Grass-type Woodear Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 0.9 m tall and weighs 33 kg. It evolves into Toedscruel. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (100), with a base stat total of 335.
